0: until pg_isready -q -h ${APP}-cnpg-rw -p 5432 -U postgres -d postgres; do sleep 2; done

while true; do
  t=$(curl -fsS -m 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}s' "$CHECK_URL") \
    && q="success=true&duration=$t" \
    || q="success=false&error=home-assistant+unreachable"
  curl -fsS -m 10 -o /dev/null -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATUS_TOKEN" "$PUSH_URL?$q" \
    || echo "push failed ($q)"
  sleep 60
done

set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /tmp/src
wget -qO /tmp/src.tar.gz "https://github.com/qoomon/smart-life-webapp/archive/28676c8bb68309918a1a4c38a947024a944f2115.tar.gz"
tar -xzf /tmp/src.tar.gz -C /tmp/src --strip-components=1
cd /tmp/src
sed -i 's#"publicPath": "/smart-life-webapp/"#"publicPath": "/"#' package.json
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
npm run build
cp -r dist/. /public/
(ip rule del table 51820; ip -6 rule del table 51820) || true

p, role:devs, applications, get, */*, allow
p, role:devs, applications, create, */*, allow
p, role:devs, applications, update, */*, allow
p, role:devs, applications, delete, */*, allow
p, role:devs, applications, sync, */*, allow
p, role:devs, applications, override, */*, allow
p, role:devs, logs, get, */*, allow
p, role:devs, projects, get, *, allow
p, role:devs, repositories, get, *, allow
p, role:devs, repositories, create, *, allow
p, role:devs, repositories, update, *, allow
p, role:devs, repositories, delete, *, allow

g, admins, role:admin
g, people, role:devs
g, readonly, role:readonly
